releaseNotes:
Smart Life v0.12.8 (14186)
- Work Hours now shows Start, End, and Total in one compact row.
- Break is removed from the Work Hours design while old saved break data remains preserved for historical totals.
- Voice controls are shown only for Normal notes and are hidden from Work Hours.
- Worked/Off only, Vacation migration, and numeric AM/PM time entry from v0.12.7 are preserved.
- One-tap Gmail Notes backup, Arabic RTL PDF, JSON restore copy, and local-first behavior remain preserved.
